steps: 1. Refresh **Tweaker: Weapons Dev**, launch, confirm `[wt:LOAD] v0.12.344-dev`. In a mission with any weapon wielded, open Mod Options, Tweaker: Weapons Dev, "Dev: Weapon Hold Pose Tuner"; enable "Enable Hold-Pose Tuner" and "Enable third-person tuner".

2. Under "Third Person" then "Right hand", set "RH Offset X (metres)" to a nonzero value: a single bottom-center row appears reading "Hold Pose | Third Person | Right Hand | Pos X ..." with your exact value at three decimals.
3. Edit "RH Rotation yaw (deg, Euler Y)": the row's Y rotation updates at one decimal. Edit a "Left hand" slider: the row flips to "Left Hand".
4. Enable "Enable first-person tuner" and edit "1P LH Offset X (metres)": the row flips to "First Person | Left Hand".
5. Turn "Enable Hold-Pose Tuner" OFF: the row disappears immediately; reopen the menu and confirm every slider kept its value.
6. Return to the keep without a wielded live unit: the row is absent. Run `/wt_regression_test`.
assertions: The row exists only while master + channel + live unit all hold, always names the focused channel and hand, and its numbers match the applied pose exactly; no internal item key ever appears. `issue1023_live_hold_pose_hud` passes in the regression run.
Enable tuner in a mission, edit a slider; assert HUD row text equals the formatter output of the applied plan and row is absent with master off; issue1023 check.
